entries.name: Co-Founder & Engineer · Mrrlin, AI execution workspace
entries.descr: A workspace that takes one goal and returns finished work by coordinating the coding agents a team already uses. In daily use by our team.
bullets: Orchestration: a Director agent turns a goal into a plan of tasks and routes each one to Claude Code, Codex CLI or another model by task type, with routing aware of subscription usage.
Quality gates: multi-model consensus review sends weak output back for another round; a task closes only with proof: a live URL, a green build or a human sign-off.
Isolation & memory: every task runs in its own git worktree with its artifacts recorded; decisions go to project memory, so the next task starts with context.
Human in the loop: one approval inbox for decisions; autopilot runs unattended and stops at approval points.

Own engineering harness: blind-anchor consensus reviews across Claude, Codex and Gemini CLIs before implementation and before every PR, a worktree per task, handoff state files and progress logs so any agent can resume a task.

entries.name: Co-Founder & Engineer · ELI, AI language tutor
entries.descr: AI English tutor for pronunciation and goal-based speaking practice (job interviews, work meetings, relocation). Live with real learners: 52 active paid subscriptions, ~780 users; revenue Stripe-verified on TrustMRR. Owned the technical side end to end: architecture, backend, frontend, AI pipeline, payments, infrastructure, CI/CD.
bullets: Backend & infrastructure: fully serverless, event-driven AWS stack (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, DynamoDB, CloudFront, Cognito) plus GCP Cloud Functions, Firestore and Firebase Auth.
AI pipeline: LLM orchestration with LangChain and fine-tuned GPT models; Whisper speech recognition on serverless GPU; phoneme-level pronunciation scoring with real-time feedback.
Learner model: a profile updated after every conversation (weak sounds, vocabulary gaps, progress toward a goal) that sets dialogue difficulty, vocabulary and scenarios.
Payments: Stripe subscriptions with tiers by speaking minutes; webhooks on GCP Cloud Functions with Firestore, tied to Firebase Auth and user management.

entries.name: Frontend Engineer → Frontend Tech Lead · robota.ua
entries.descr: Ukraine's largest job board (6.5M+ resumes, 100K+ active listings). Moved a .NET/jQuery monolith to Angular + GraphQL (Apollo) services with a Tailwind design system and built the mobile SPA. As tech lead of the frontend platform: cut CI build time from ~40 to ~20 min (TeamCity to GitHub Actions, incremental builds, caching), moved key pages from red to green Core Web Vitals, introduced TypeScript strict mode, SonarQube and Sentry. Built a serverless GEOHASH-based ETA service for public transport on GCP that reduced Google Maps API costs.
